title: focus.json
description: Firm focus mode: refuses new distractions rather than tearing down a running session. Read by the media browser and game launchers (refuse-to-start, with a reason) and by do-not-disturb; never by anything that would kill an already-running session.

mode.description: "off" is the default, unrestricted state. "focus" blocks the launches enforce.md lists until `until`, or forever if `until` is null.

until.description: ISO-8601 timestamp focus mode lapses at, or null for an open-ended session that only an explicit stop ends.
